events.text: The Board of Directors approved the INSEE Sustainability Ambition 2030 pillars and targets in 2023 and assigned the Group CEO to establish the Sustainability Steering Committee (SSC).
SCG's 2025 Sustainability Report reports 29.06 million tCO2e of GHG emissions and a 15.14% reduction from the 2020 baseline.

The Pollution Control Department's investigation revealed that surface water around Siam Cement's facility has high levels of acidity and lead contamination, underground water quality at 12 locations was below standard, and a watercourse was contaminated, resulting in a significant fine on soil pollution.
Pattaya City officials inspected environmental issues caused by a cement plant near Sukhumvit Soi 91/1 in response to complaints about dust pollution.
